label: accepted_00000055
center_convention: analytic center elimination: a_000 = (1 - c_l - sum_{i>=1} s_i a_i)/s_0; the P/high state with this relation is the authoritative state; a_canonical_decimal50 is the exact rational checkpoint rounded to 50 digits at the end (F15, D3 (f))

input_exact_for_checkpoint.input_exact_for_checkpoint_method: Fraction(c_l) and Fraction of every binary64 P and high coordinate; a_000 = (1 - c_l - sum_k s_k a_k)/s_0 in Fractions (strains rational in c_l); N_n as exact Fractions of the frozen binary64 constants; integer Legendre factors; T1 map exact (SPEC v9.17)
input_exact_for_checkpoint.serialization: first line 'cl num/den' (binary64 c_l as an exact rational), then the newline-joined numerator/denominator of the 860 canonical coefficients in canonical order I(j,m,k)
input_exact_for_checkpoint.binary64_inputs_serialization: little-endian float64 bytes of P (60, c_l first) followed by high (800)

a_canonical_decimal50_rounded_note: the exact rational checkpoint (input_exact_for_checkpoint) rounded to 50 significant digits; the P/high state is authoritative
a_canonical_float_note: binary64 display values of the Decimal canonical coefficients; rounding a_000 to binary64 leaves a center defect of order 1e-16 (verifier F15), so these are not the authoritative state

rounding_bound.definition: SPEC v9.3 section 11 indicator with the v9.12 arithmetic (fsum, root-weight term h, C = 2^-51 J); not a rigorous bound
